# 2.1.0

- Add the server-only `wenay-common2/https` manager and installed `wenay-https` CLI with idempotent
  `ensure`, `status`, `doctor`, and `stop` operations for an existing application backend.
- Install pinned Caddy releases into a shared verified user cache, preserve ACME accounts,
  certificates, and private keys outside projects, serialize project operations, verify PID
  ownership before stopping, and expose served-certificate diagnostics without reading private keys.
- Document automatic-renewal startup and authenticated-administration boundaries, plus a reusable
  project-owned `.d.ts` generation/watch pattern for both TypeScript and React TSX projects.
